ground_truth_facts_the_oracle_used.missing_required_flag: --as-of-date (cli.py:411) is required and is never passed by the unmodified probe. CORRECTED per review finding F-I14A-02: the child's return code is UNOBSERVABLE to that tool (its _resolve discards the subprocess result and records no per-call rc), so no baseline may state a child exit code. What IS reproducible (before/cmd-E5b/stderr.txt) is that the probe's own reader thread dies with UnicodeDecodeError while decoding the child's GBK stderr on this host — six times — while the probe still exits 0 with breaches=[]; the tool therefore cannot attribute a child failure to its own verdict even in principle.
